# Generated by ppc finalize (location_profiles.py) from the buildings and the plan list; do not edit by hand.

# Country scope: 1 while a location of the country holds a plan (the Locations rule group runs and its weight
# counts: pp_cplan_profiles_cw, pp_construction_plan_generated.txt). Read from the cached country variable
# pp_lprof_any (pp_lprof_any_refresh: every pass's start, switching the plan on, a plan set or taken off), never by a
# walk: the window's always-visible rows evaluate it about a hundred times a frame (script profile 2026-11-20:
# 6.1 s of 15 s with the trigger pp_lprof_has_locations here).
pp_lprof_group_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_any }
		value = 1
	}
}

# Location scope, in the pass (scope:pp_cplan_btype and the cost values set): the payback of its next level + 100,
# compared with the limit (+ 100); 1 + the build cost, the start picker's key (never 0, which is unset).
pp_lprof_payback100 = {
	value = pp_cplan_est_payback_years
	add = 100
}
pp_lprof_cost1 = {
	value = pp_cplan_est_cost
	add = 1
}

# Location scope, in the pass (a first level or a tier upgrade under a payback limit; scope:pp_cplan_btype, the
# cost values and scope:pp_lprof_newp = the Businesses rule's monthly profit estimate of one level set): its
# payback in years + 100, as pp_lprof_payback100 (1099 = no profit).
pp_lprof_new_payback100 = {
	value = 1099
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_lprof_newp > 0.001 }
		value = pp_cplan_est_cost
		divide = scope:pp_lprof_newp
		divide = 12
		max = 999
		add = 100
	}
}
